experiment: E17 UML3 palettes in CATIA Magic: custom symbolic view definitions whose palette buttons create UML3 keyword elements
setup: Slice E17a, loaded into the project that already holds the UML3 libraries and examples: customization/catia-magic/UML3CatiaMagic.sysml (template packages with one unnamed keyword element each, e.g. package classTemplate { #classType item def; }; UML3ClassPalette :> DS_Views::ViewPalettes::GeneralPalette with a 'UML3 Classifiers' and a 'UML3 Relationships' category of OperationFromTemplate buttons, plus predefined OperationFromCode buttons; view def 'UML3 Class Diagram' :> UML3Views::ClassDiagram, DS_Views::CoreViews::bsv and 'UML3 Class Detail Diagram' :> UML3Views::ClassDetailDiagram, bsv, each redefining baseViewPalette with UML3ClassPalette) and customization/catia-magic/examples/OnlineStoreCatiaMagicViews.sysml (views of OnlineStoreDomain typed by both). Checks: builder errors on load, validation engine on UML3CatiaMagic and OnlineStoreCatiaMagicViews, tools/cameo-scripts/verifyPalettes.groovy (DSLService visualization and palette: categories, buttons, operations, template elements and their keyword metadata), exportViewDiagrams.groovy (display mode, shapes, SVG labels, overlaps).

predictions.claim: Both files load with 0 builder errors: the DS names resolve through the imports, and unnamed keyword definitions in template packages are legal
predictions.observation: Run 1 (2026-09-17 13:1x): UML3CatiaMagic.sysml and OnlineStoreCatiaMagicViews.sysml loaded with 0 builder errors

predictions.claim: The validation engine reports no ERROR on UML3CatiaMagic or OnlineStoreCatiaMagicViews, although each view definition specializes both a UML3 view definition and bsv

Without reloading the project (only DSLService.resetCache()), the visualization of a view typed by 'UML3 Class Diagram' is a SymbolicVisualization whose palette lists the inherited Selections, Tools and Common categories and the new 'UML3 Classifiers' and 'UML3 Relationships' categories with their button labels
predictions.observation: After DSLService.resetCache() the DSL lists only the vendor visualizations (Visualization ... General View, Interconnection View); 'UML3 Class Diagram' is not among them and the views of both UML3 definitions get the General View visualization and palette (12 categories, no UML3 category). Cause found in the bytecode of com.dassault_systemes.modeler.sysml.dsl.a.g (read): the registry is built breadth-first from DS_Views::CoreViews::Visualization over subclassifications, keeping a subtype only when its FIRST owned subclassification targets the parent. 'UML3 Class Diagram' :> UML3Views::ClassDiagram, bsv has UML3Views::ClassDiagram first, so it is never reached; the vendor's own 'General View' :> bsv, gv lists bsv first. A view whose definition is not registered falls back by rendering kind to General View (symbolic) or Generic Table (tabular).

predictions.claim: Every templated button's OperationFromTemplate.getTemplate() is the unnamed template element of the expected kind carrying the expected UML3 keyword metadata (class -> item def with ClassMetadata; data type -> attribute def with DataTypeMetadata; association -> connection def with AssociationMetadata; uses -> dependency with UsesDependency)

A view typed by 'UML3 Class Diagram' gets DisplayMode TREE: the rendering of UML3Views::ClassDiagram (render asTreeDiagram, first general type) wins over the asInterconnectionDiagram rendering that bsv inherits from 'Symbolic View'
A view typed by 'UML3 Class Detail Diagram' gets DisplayMode NESTED (the only inherited rendering is asInterconnectionDiagram), not UNDEFINED like UML3Views::ClassDetailDiagram

The views typed by the CATIA Magic definitions expose the same elements as example 05's domainClassDiagram and domainClassDetails (the UML3Views filters are inherited): the includes and excludes of VW1 and VW10 hold
DSLService.isDSLValid() stays true after the load
predictions.observation: DSL|valid|true after the load and resetCache()

predictions.claim: After resetCache(), without reloading the project, E17V1-E17V6 (bsv as first general) are registered visualizations under 'Base Symbolic View', and E17V0 (UML3Views::ClassDiagram first) is not
The views of the registered variants get UML3ClassPalette: the UML3 Classifiers and UML3 Relationships categories, and no Actions, Other Actions, States or Cases category

Each templated button resolves to its template element: class and interface -> ItemDefinition with ClassMetadata / InterfaceTypeMetadata, data type -> AttributeDefinition with DataTypeMetadata, association -> ConnectionDefinition with AssociationMetadata, uses -> Dependency with UsesDependency
DisplayMode: v0 TREE (first general's rendering), v1 NESTED (bsv first, so sv's asInterconnectionDiagram), v2 TREE and v3 TREE (owned rendering), v4 NESTED, v5 TREE (redefined rendering), v6 unknown

Validation engine: validateViewDefinitionOnlyOneViewRendering flags E17V0, E17V1 (two inherited renderings), E17V2 (owned plus two inherited) and E17V3 (owned plus sv's); E17V4 (only sv's) and E17V5 (the owned rendering redefines sv's) are not flagged; E17V6 unknown
